spanish: A Dios no maldecirás, y a príncipe en tu pueblo no maldecirás.

findings.issue: H7043 piel and H779 qal are different lemmas and stems, but both are rendered maldecirás, so the lexical distinction is omitted.
Spanish personal a is grammatical smoothing; the object tokens have no preposition.

notes: Dios, singular príncipe, 2ms futures, and en tu pueblo match the remaining tokens.
